The new agent has no KV record (recover_containment_at_start returns early, :2993-2996), firewall.release on the new id resets defaults to Windows' own and leaves the previously enabled rules disabled for good (:2225-2296); the old id's QuarantineStore record ends only by DELETE ?force=true (ADR-0047 clause 5).
